sloka: एको हि अहम् अयोध्याम् च पृथिवीम् च अपि लक्ष्मण ।तरेयम् इषुभिः क्रुद्धो ननु वीर्यम् अकारणम् ॥२-५३-२५॥
transliteration: eko hi aham ayodhyām ca pṛthivīm ca api lakṣmaṇa ।tareyam iṣubhiḥ kruddho nanu vīryam akāraṇam ॥2-53-25॥

translations.english: Once enraged, O Lakshmana I can overpower Ayodhya, even the whole world all by myself with my arrows. But exhibition of prowess without any reason is not desirable.
